beats.label: The Gospel is taken up from the altar
Out through the north deacon door
Down from the solea into the nave
Across the nave, in front of the people
Around the tetrapod to the ambon
“Wisdom! Be attentive!” The Gospel is raised before the doors
The Gospel is laid on the altar
The gifts are taken up at the prothesis
Out through the north deacon door
Down the north aisle, among the people
Across the back of the nave
Up the center aisle through the people
Around the tetrapod to the ambon
The commemorations: “May the Lord God remember all of you…”
The gifts are set on the altar
